Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2
Looked up for Sarah: Thor P2 is live at $369, down from $449, 10 TH/s at about 166 watts — roughly $12 a month in power at 10¢. Ships October 3.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about ten cents the Hammer Miner Thor P2 costs around $12 a month to run. It's $369, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Garage works well for the Thor P2. At around ten cents, it's about twelve dollars a month in power. Is this your first miner?
Looked up for Sarah: Thor P2 comes with its power supply and cord, runs about 40 dB, and sets up over WiFi or ethernet — fine as a first miner.

Great first pick. You'll run a real piece of the Bitcoin network from your garage, learn pools and wallets hands-on, and every ten minutes it takes a shot at a full block. Want the sats per month next?
